p: And God saw the light, that it was good: and God divided the light
a: from the darkness

p: And God said, Let the earth bring forth grass, the herb yielding seed, and the fruit tree yielding fruit
a: after his kind
s: , whose seed is in itself, upon the earth: and it was so.

p: And God saw every thing that he had made, and, behold, it was
a: very good
s: . And the evening and the morning were the sixth day.

p: And God blessed the seventh day, and sanctified it: because that in it
a: he had rested from all his work
s: which God created and made.
d: the host of them was ended

p: And the LORD God took the man, and put him into the garden of Eden
a: to dress it and to keep it

p: But Noah
a: found grace in the eyes of the LORD

p: After these things the word of the LORD came unto Abram in a vision, saying, Fear not, Abram: I am thy shield, and
a: thy exceeding great reward

p: That be far from thee to do after this manner, to slay the righteous with the wicked: and that the righteous should be as the wicked, that be far from thee: Shall not the Judge of all the earth
a: do right?

p: And he said, O LORD God of my master Abraham, I pray thee, send me good speed this day, and
a: shew kindness unto my master
s: Abraham.
d: hear the prayer of my heart

p: And the LORD was with Joseph, and he was
a: a prosperous man
s: ; and he was in the house of his master the Egyptian.

p: I have waited for
a: thy salvation, O LORD

p: Joseph is a fruitful bough, even
a: a fruitful bough by a well
s: ; whose branches run over the wall:
d: a green tree in the field

p: And Joseph said unto his brethren, I die: and
a: God will surely visit you
s: , and bring you out of this land unto the land which he sware to Abraham, to Isaac, and to Jacob.
d: the LORD shall preserve your seed
the Almighty shall redeem your house

p: I am the LORD thy God, which have brought thee out of the land of Egypt,
a: out of the house of bondage

p: Then said the LORD unto Moses, Behold, I will rain
a: bread from heaven
s: for you; and the people shall go out and gather a certain rate every day, that I may prove them, whether they will walk in my law, or no.

p: Moreover thou shalt provide out of all the people able men,
a: such as fear God, men of truth
s: , hating covetousness; and place such over them, to be rulers of thousands, and rulers of hundreds, rulers of fifties, and rulers of tens:
d: elders among the people of Israel
princes of the tribes of Judah

p: Thou shalt not take the name of the LORD thy God in vain; for the LORD will not hold him guiltless that taketh
a: his name in vain
Thou shalt not kill
Thou shalt not steal

p: Thou shalt not bear
a: false witness
s: against thy neighbour.

p: And ye shall serve the LORD your God, and
a: he shall bless thy bread, and thy water
s: ; and I will take sickness away from the midst of thee.
d: he shall make thee plenteous in goods
he shall give thee peace in thy borders
he shall lengthen the days of thy life

p: And he said, Behold, I make a covenant: before all thy people
a: I will do marvels
s: , such as have not been done in all the earth, nor in any nation: and all the people among which thou art shall see the work of the LORD: for it is a terrible thing that I will do with thee.

p: Then a cloud covered the tent of the congregation, and
a: the glory of the LORD filled the tabernacle
d: the presence of God descended upon the mount
the fire of the altar was kindled
the holy cloud removed from the camp

a: Thou shalt not hate thy brother
s: in thine heart: thou shalt in any wise rebuke thy neighbour, and not suffer sin upon him.
d: Thou shalt not oppress the stranger
Thou shalt not avenge the wrong
Thou shalt not bear a grudge

p: Ye shall keep my sabbaths, and
a: reverence my sanctuary
s: : I am the LORD.

p: And ye shall keep my statutes, and do them:
a: I am the LORD which sanctify you
d: I am the LORD your holy Redeemer
I am the God of Abraham your father
I am the LORD that brought you forth

a: Neither shall ye profane my holy name
s: ; but I will be hallowed among the children of Israel: I am the LORD which hallow you,
d: Neither shall ye despise my commandments
Neither shall ye pollute my altar with sin
Neither shall ye break my everlasting oath

a: Ye shall not therefore oppress one another
s: ; but thou shalt fear thy God: for I am the LORD your God.
d: Ye shall not take usury of thy brethren
Ye shall not withhold the pledge of the poor
Ye shall not pervert the cause of the needy

p: And if thy brother be waxen poor, and fallen in decay with thee; then
a: thou shalt relieve him
s: : yea, though he be a stranger, or a sojourner; that he may live with thee.

p: And
a: I will give peace in the land
s: , and ye shall lie down, and none shall make you afraid: and I will rid evil beasts out of the land, neither shall the sword go through your land.
d: I will open the windows of heaven
I will establish my covenant with you
I will drive out all your adversaries

p: And I will set
a: my tabernacle among you
s: : and my soul shall not abhor you.

p: Only rebel not ye against the LORD, neither fear ye the people of the land; for they are bread for us: their defence is departed from them, and the LORD is with us:
a: fear them not

p: And they will tell it to the inhabitants of this land: for they have heard that thou LORD art among this people, that thou LORD
a: art seen face to face
s: , and that thy cloud standeth over them, and that thou goest before them, by day time in a pillar of a cloud, and in a pillar of fire by night.

p: And Moses made a serpent of brass, and put it upon a pole, and it came to pass, that if a serpent had bitten any man, when
a: he beheld the serpent of brass, he lived
d: he called upon the LORD, he was healed
he looked unto the altar, his plague ceased
he confessed his iniquity, his soul was saved

p: Behold, I have received commandment to bless: and he hath blessed; and
a: I cannot reverse it
How goodly are thy tents, O Jacob
s: , and thy tabernacles, O Israel!
d: How blessed is the nation of Israel
Great is the beauty of thy dwelling
Peace be within thy high places

p: He hath said, which heard the words of God, and knew
a: the knowledge of the most High
s: , which saw the vision of the Almighty, falling into a trance, but having his eyes open:
d: the deep things of the Spirit

p: He hath not beheld iniquity in Jacob, neither hath he seen perverseness in Israel: the LORD his God is with him, and
a: the shout of a king is among them
d: the glory of his power shall abide
the ark of the covenant shall lead them
the blessing of the Almighty is upon them

p: So ye shall not pollute the land wherein ye are:
a: for blood it defileth the land
s: : and the land cannot be cleansed of the blood that is shed therein, but by the blood of him that shed it.
d: for murder is an abomination before him

a: Ye shall not add unto the word
s: which I command you, neither shall ye diminish ought from it, that ye may keep the commandments of the LORD your God which I command you.
d: Ye shall not turn aside from the law
Ye shall not despise the commandment
Ye shall not forget the covenant

p: For the LORD thy God is
a: a consuming fire
s: , even a jealous God.

p: Hear, O Israel:
a: The LORD our God is one LORD
d: The LORD our God is God alone
The LORD our God is holy and true
The LORD our God is King of all

p: Therefore thou shalt love the LORD thy God, and
a: keep his charge, and his statutes
s: , and his judgments, and his commandments, alway.
d: walk in all his holy ways
serve him with a true heart

p: What thing soever I command you, observe to do it: thou shalt not add thereto,
a: nor diminish from it

p: And all these blessings shall
a: come on thee, and overtake thee
s: , if thou shalt hearken unto the voice of the LORD thy God.
d: abide with thee, and preserve thee
multiply upon thee and thy children
enrich thy store and thy basket

p: For this commandment which I command thee this day,
a: it is not hidden from thee
s: , neither is it far off.
d: it is not too hard for thee
it is not burdensome unto you
it is not sealed in heaven

p: Because I will publish the name of the LORD:
a: ascribe ye greatness unto our God
d: praise his holy name for ever

p: Happy art thou, O Israel: who is like unto thee,
a: O people saved by the LORD
s: , the shield of thy help, and who is the sword of thy excellency! and thine enemies shall be found liars unto thee; and thou shalt tread upon their high places.
d: O nation holy in his sight
O children of the living God

p: And there arose not a prophet since in Israel like unto Moses,
a: whom the LORD knew face to face
d: who did all the signs in the land of Egypt
who spake the words of this law in the mount
who bare the ark of the covenant before Israel
